page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Each numbered item (XVII to XXI) is one paragraph with Greek and references set inline. At the foot right stands the catchword XXII. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: XVII. Capite x, versu 36 [?], vocat εὐαγγέλιον [?], objectivè & terminativè, vitam æternam, statum gloriæ. Plane Galat. iii. 22. ἵνα ἡ ἐπαγγελία [illegible, ~10 letters] τοῖς πιστεύουσι [?].
XVIII. Capite x, versu 39, εἰς περιποίησιν ψυχῆς. Eodem sensu Paulus 1. Thess. v. 9. εἰς περιποίησιν σωτηρίας. II. Thess. ii. 14. εἰς περιποίησιν δόξης.

XIX. Capite xii. versu 1, vitam Christianam confert Apostolus, cum iis qui currunt in stadio; τρέχωμεν τὸν προκείμενον ἡμῖν ἀγῶνα [?]. Similitudo Paulina, 1. Corinth. ix, 24. & sequent. τρέχοντες μὲν πάντες [illegible, ~12 letters] εἷς λαμβάνει τὸ βραβεῖον [?]. Ibidem usus vocem ἀγωνίζεσθαι, quæ respondet voci ἀγὼν.
XX. Capite xiii. versu 9. διδαχαῖς παντοίαις μὴ παραφέρεσθε. Plane sic Apostolus Ephes. iv. 14. περιφερόμενοι παντὶ ἀνέμῳ τῆς διδασκαλίας.

XXI. Capite xiii. versu 10, utitur phrasi ϑ [?], Φαγεῖν ἐκ θυσιαστηρίου [?], vesci altaris, i.e. victimâ. Idem omninò 1. Corinth. ix, 13. τῷ θυσιαστηρίῳ συμμερίζεσθαι, eodem significatu. Item 1. Cor. x, 18. κοινωνοὶ τῷ θυσιαστηρίῳ.

page.notes: The page number reads "198" with the last digits partly blotted, so it is marked [?]. The running head is heavily inked; "Epistolæ" is uncertain. The Greek is blurred throughout: accents and several words are doubtful and are marked [?] or illegible. The verse number in XVII (36) is doubtful. The catchword "XXII." stands at the foot right.
